~
Intro: Smudge is on a white fence looking out into the forest, the words "Cradles" show up. Rusty jumps onto the fence and the words "An Evil Au Smudge" shows up. Smudge looks at Rusty and smiles, (Only Smudge on this panel) words say "A Complete MAP" The two are talking back faced to the forest. They jump down and run into the forest, the words "Enjoy" are with them as they run.
~
1: Rusty and Smudge are hunting a mouse when Graypaw tackles Rusty and runs into a tree. The mouse runs off and Smudge tenses, getting ready to attack.
~
2: Smudge attacks Graypaw, shoving him over Rusty and bitting his front left legs. Graypaw kicks Smudge off of him and growls. 
~
3: Bluestar and appears, all the cats freeze, Graypaw dips his head down in a shameful way. Rusty and Smudge stand confused.
~
4: Bluestar looks at the two kittypets, talking (Not really just makes it look like it) to the three. Graypaw looks proud, Rusty and Smudge look surprised.
~
5: The four walk through the forest, reaching Thunderclan camp. Bluestar jumps onto the High rock and meows.
~
6: Longtail jumps out of nowhere and attacks the two kittypets, he takes down Rusty, then luges at Smugde.
~
7: Longtail rips off Smudges collar and Smudges bits him on the ear. They both skid back. 
~
8: Bluestar hops down from the High rock and looks approvingly at the kittypets. Longtail slips back into the shadows.
~
9: Ravenpaw bursts into camp, looking terrified, blood on his right front paw, tears in his eyes. His panting and then collapse. 
~
10: His taken to the med den, (by black cats) Tigerclaw comes out and breaks the news. Gryapw looks sad and Bluestar astonished.
~
11: Bluestar walks away, heads down and Spottedpaw & Firepaw (Rusty & Smudge) follow her.  
~
12: It Spottedpaw is carrying a dead mouse in his month, when over a bush he sees the dead body of Redtail, blood pouring out of his neck. Tigerclaw is next to him, picking him up by his scruff.
~
13: Spottedpaw follows Tigerclaw, a trail of blood in front of Spottedpaw. Tigerclaw throws his body into a river, staining it red. Spottedpaw stares and the river with a smile. 
~
14: It shows Spottedpaw, Firepaw, Graypaw and Ravenpaw in the app den, sleeping. Spottedpaw gets up, and walks out of the cave, into the warriors den. He stands over Longtail, claws ready and strikes him in the neck.
~
15: It's Spottedpaw, Graypaw, Firepaw & Ravenpaw in front of the Highrock. It then switchs to Bluestar on the High rock talking.Then it switches to them individually all looking happy. Except Spottedpaw, he has a creepy grin on his face. (Show Spottedpaw when the song says "tension") (PMV)
~  
16: Spottedpatch and Graystripe are in the forest talking. Spottedpatch is smile and unsheathed his claws on "honesty" it shows Spottedpatch killing Graystripe.
~
17: Spottedpatch his walking in the forest, watching Fireheart he leaps out of the bush's and attacks Fireheart, slicing his back left leg. Fireheart yowls and kicks Spottedpatch off, looking confused and terrified at his friend, Spottedpatch runs into the forest.
~
18: Spottedpatch reaches Thunderclan. Bluestar hisses at him, and Ravenfeather his looking horrified. A group of black cats surround Spottedpatch. Spottedpatch runs off.
~
19: Spottedpatch meets Scourge, they talk and Spottedpatch smiles murderously. Fireheart is watching from the bushes
~
20: Scar (Spottedpatch) and Scourge and a whole band of cats, are facing Ravenstar, Fireheart and Thunderclan. Scar leaps and tackles Fireheart. Killing him. Ravenstar flinches back, looking scared.
~
21: Scar and Scourge smile, as Thunderclan backs away. Ravenstar has tears in his eyes. (Scar has bloodstains on his paws)
~
Outro: Scar is in Ravenstar's den, standing over him. He ununsheathed his claws and strikes Ravenstar.  Scar walks away happily. Ravenstar wakes up in Starclan. and starts to cry. It fades to black and words appear "Thanks for watching" (Starclan cats are all around Ravenstar)
